==Description==
'''Desert Oasis''' is a normal [[maps|map]] exclusive to [[PVP]].

==Design & Path==
'''Desert Oasis''' is a sanctuary located in a desert. The playable area is surrounded by multiple desert walls. It has two nearly identical parts except for certain spots being colored red instead of blue. These are split by a small pool of water with two bridges to cross it. These areas contain various sandstone structures colored after the teams. Outside the sanctuary, there is nothing except sand and some pyramids in the distance.

The path starts and ends at an entrance located in the desert walls of the oasis. The sandstone path takes multiple turns, avoiding all the objects located on the map.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Desert Oasis}}

==Strategy==
*High range towers can be useful here, as they can cover most of the path from the middle of the path.
*This map contains multiple pay layouts which match up great with the [[Ace Pilot]]'s circle flight path.

==Trivia==
*Unlike all other maps added on the release of [[PVP]], this is not actually based on any maps which were present in early versions of [[PVP Test]].
**This also means this map which was never present in [[PVP Test]] got added to the game before the [[Unreleased 2025 PVP Maps|multiple already remade maps]] from there, such as [[Unreleased 2025 PVP Maps#PVP_11|PVP_11]].
